label: Waste electrical and electronic equipment (WEEE) by waste management operations - open scope, 6 product categories (from 2018 onwards)

label.EE6: Waste arising only from separate collection of EEE (6 categories methodology defined in WEEE directive)
label.EE_SME: Screens, monitors, and equipment containing screens having a surface greater than 100 cm2
label.EE_LE: Large equipment (any external dimension more than 50 cm)
label.EE_SE: Small equipment (no external dimension more than 50 cm)
label.EE_SITTE: Small IT and telecommunications equipment (no external dimension more than 50 cm)

label.TRT_NAT: Waste treated in the Member State
label.TRT_EU_FOR: Waste treated in another Member State of the EU

label.i: value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies
label.bi: break in time series, value imputed by Eurostat or other receiving agencies
